description: Reviews API: List Yelp reviews. The reviews Yelp recommends for a business, as `Review` objects, with the owner's public reply. `stars`, `sort` and `search` are applied by Yelp; `language`, `since` and `until` on each page. Sorting by rating can time out on Yelp's side for businesses with many thousands of reviews: use `stars` instead. `meta.entity` is the business. A page that returns nothing only because of the filters, with `has_more` true, is free. Price: 8 credits per call; failed calls are free. Paginated: pass pagination.next_cursor as `cursor` for the next page (each page is a new call).

limit.description: Reviews per page (max 20, one page of the source)

name: reviews_yelp_business_reviews
title: List Yelp reviews
